name: wardrobe
description: Wardrobe — saved outfits over a container furniture flagged `wardrobe`. Drag-and-drop paper doll in the client panel; wearing an outfit dresses you from what's hanging inside.

outfit.note: The discoverable verb on a wardrobe is `outfits` (a specialized action, so examine surfaces it). `outfit save|wear|delete` is the typed sibling that listing points at, and the panel is the primary path.
